CFML Language Reference: Functions

Year

Returns the year part of a date/time value as a four-digit number.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

Year(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

A number such as 1999 or 2000.

Usage

Same as DatePart("yyyy", date). If the string has a two-digit year, the sliding window described under ParseDateTime applies: "10/22/99" is 1999 and "1/1/00" is 2000.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Date</TH><TH>Year</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="D" LIST="10/22/99,1/1/00,12/31/29,1/1/30,Jan 1 2000">
<TR><TD>#D#</TD><TD>#Year(D)#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
<TR><TD>Now()</TD><TD>#Year(Now())#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also
